content.short: Gnosis Pay is a self-custodial stablecoin Visa card and white-label card platform bridging DeFi and payments.
content.description: Gnosis Pay is a self-custodial payments network that connects on-chain stablecoins to the Visa card network, letting users spend directly from their own smart-contract wallet. Purchases pull stablecoins such as USDC, EURe and GBPe from the user's Safe account at checkout, so funds stay non-custodial until spent. Built on Gnosis Chain and reaching Ethereum and Polygon, it also offers a white-label program that lets wallets, neobanks and exchanges launch their own branded stablecoin cards. Serving consumers and businesses across Europe and other markets, Gnosis Pay has deployed tens of thousands of accounts and processed over 100 million dollars in volume.
